fields.Name: T2p -> S-T.4
fields.Description: Gate G2.26 (phase 2, dataset T2p, criterion S-T.4): inner folds are blocked in time with a gap ≥ h and grouped by entity, with 0 entity keys shared across a fold boundary; the blocked-split RMSE lies inside the reference's [1.5123, 1.6082], and the random-row split's inflation is stored beside it. It fails when the blocked inner folds drop the gap h (shared keys across a boundary > 0 or the RMSE leaves the band).

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: Blocked inner folds grouped by entity share 0 keys and keep the gap (1 and 2 periods); the shipped RMSE is the reference's 1.5591 with its interval at [1.5123, 1.6082]; the random-row contrast on the same 2,000 rows is reported (1 of 1 pytest case passes).
